title: Battle of Agra
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Agra", at revision 1370431091, opens: "The Battle of Agra was a comparatively minor but nevertheless decisive action at the end of a prolonged siege during the Indian Rebellion of 1857." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q4087406, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "This was a battle during the Indian Rebellion of 1857.". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
